run_DOOM_experiment: run an APPO RL training experiment on Doom basic environments with 500M env steps
create_ParamGrid: create a ParamGrid with seed and env parameters for Doom environment experiments
build_Experiment: build an Experiment with APPO algorithm config and frameskip 4 for Doom basic envs
configure_RunDescription: configure a RunDescription with experiments for paper Doom basic envs using APPO v97
generate_params: generate randomized or ordered parameter combinations from a ParamGrid for RL experiments
